name: v0.4.10 — Receipt cleanup tools
releaseNotes:
• New on the Receipts screen: tap the ⋮ menu → “Find duplicates” to merge repeat receipts, or “Auto-categorize” to label uncategorized ones.
• Under the hood: a diagnostic to finally pin down the receipt-font rendering on some phones.

Uninstall the old app first, then install this one fresh.
